notes_for_editor: Only source is the tnlandforms.us list (map marked revised 22 March 2016). Two WebSearch queries (Heard County, Rockridge, Hogansville, Franklin) found no history for this tower. NHLR has no page for it (404 on nhlr.org/lookouts/us/ga/rockridge/) and the cached FFLOS Georgia index does not list it; firetower.org was unreachable. The list prints no unit for elevation; feet is inferred, and 988 ft = 301.1 m matches the record. The page header labels the last field 'GFC number', but the page does not explain gfc-416 further; the record's GFC 'US 416' is not verified against any Georgia Forestry Commission source. Status and access unknown, so no status or access keys are set. Story is deliberately short because no history source was found.
